svg.title: The bce engine, from code change to merge verdict
svg.desc: The CLI, GitHub Action, and MCP enter one runGate path. Agent code is extracted, then evaluated against a human-owned blueprint. The compliance report produces exit code zero to merge or exit code one to block with the violated rule, edge, file, and line. A failed change returns to the agent for a code fix; a policy amendment returns to human review.

g.text: FIX CODE · RUN THE SAME GATE
